title: Preoperative CALLY Index and Quantitative Left Atrial Low-Voltage Burden are Associated with Documented Recurrence After First Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: We assessed whether preoperative C-reactive protein-albumin-lymphocyte (CALLY) index and intraoperative left atrial low-voltage area (LVA) burden provide complementary prognostic information after first ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort included 259 patients. The endpoint was first documented atrial fibrillation, flutter, or tachycardia lasting ≥30 s after a 60-day blanking period. ln(1/CALLY) and LVA burden were modeled with natural cubic splines in landmark Cox models; diagnostics prompted an extended model allowing LVA effects to vary with log time.

RESULTS: There were 114 recurrences. Both exposures showed nonlinear associations (overall P<0.001; P for nonlinearity=0.011 and 0.004). Relative to the median, the 75th percentile of ln(1/CALLY), where higher values correspond to lower CALLY and a less favorable systemic profile, had HR 1.99 (95% CI 1.47-2.70). Corresponding LVA HRs were 2.41, 4.78, 7.36, and 10.21 at days 90, 150, 240, and 364, although late high-LVA support was sparse. Harrell C increased from 0.648 to 0.819 after adding both markers. Near-12-month performance was similar across fixed Cox, time-varying Cox, and fixed-horizon logistic models.

CONCLUSION: CALLY and LVA burden provided complementary systemic-host and electroanatomic information. Findings are prognostic within the observed operator-directed pathway and require external validation.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤首次消融后，术前CALLY指数和左房低电压负荷与复发独立相关，联合模型预测C指数从0.648升至0.819。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤首次消融后复发率仍较高，术前全身炎症营养状态（CALLY指数）与术中左房低电压区（LVA）负荷是否提供互补的预后信息尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入259例接受首次消融的持续性房颤患者。终点为60天空白期后首次记录到持续≥30秒的房颤、房扑或房速。采用landmark Cox模型以自然三次样条建模ln(1/CALLY)与LVA负荷，因诊断提示LVA效应随时间变化，进一步构建允许LVA效应随对数时间变化的扩展模型。
AI.result: 共114例复发。两种暴露均呈非线性关联（总体P<0.001；非线性P分别为0.011和0.004）。相对于中位数，ln(1/CALLY)第75百分位（对应较低CALLY、较差全身状态）的HR为1.99（95%CI 1.47-2.70）。LVA在90、150、240、364天对应的HR分别为2.41、4.78、7.36、10.21，但晚期高LVA支持数据稀疏。加入两标志物后Harrell C指数由0.648升至0.819。近12个月性能在固定Cox、时变Cox和固定时间窗logistic模型间相似。
AI.conclusion: CALLY指数与LVA负荷分别提供全身宿主与电解剖信息，具有互补预后价值。结果限于观察到的术者导向路径，需外部验证。

title: Association Between Colchicine Use and Clinical Outcomes Post Cardiac Surgery: A Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Colchicine has been shown to mitigate inflammation and reduce adverse cardiovascular events. However, evidence from clinical trials has been mixed regarding its efficacy in cardiovascular prevention among patients undergoing cardiac surgery.

OBJECTIVE: We aimed to evaluate the association between colchicine use and cardiovascular outcomes in patients undergoing cardiac surgery.

METHODS: We conducted a systematic literature search on various electronic databases for relevant studies from their inception until July 15, 2025. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with two arms-one with colchicine as an intervention and the other with placebo-in patients undergoing cardiac surgery were included. Risk ratios (RRs) and weighted mean differences (WMDs), along with 95% confidence intervals (CIs), were pooled using a random-effects model. A p value of < 0.05 was considered statistically significant.

RESULTS: Nine RCTs with 2005 patients (990 in the colchicine group and 1015 in the placebo group) were included. The mean age was 62.8 years. Pooled analysis demonstrated that compared with placebo, colchicine was significantly associated with a reduction in the risk of postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) (RR 0.70 [95% CI 0.59-0.83], p < 0.001). However, between the groups, there was no statistically significant difference in the risk of all-cause mortality (ACM) (RR 0.81 [95% CI 0.39-1.69], p = 0.57, I2 = 0%), stroke (RR 1.86 [95% CI 0.48-7.12], p = 0.37), and permanent pacemaker implantation (PPM) (RR 1.36 [95% CI 0.08-22.44], p = 0.83). Length of hospital stay, which was exploratory, was significantly shorter in the colchicine group (WMD - 1.16 [95% CI - 1.89 to - 0.44], p < 0.01) compared to placebo.

CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis demonstrates that colchicine appears to reduce the risk of POAF. However, it does not significantly affect the risks in terms of PPM, ACM, or stroke.

title: Frailty Burden in Patients with HFrEF Undergoing Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation: Clinical Outcomes and Readmissions.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Frailty is common and has been associated with adverse clinical outcomes across cardiovascular populations. However, its prognostic significance, particularly the impact of graded frailty burden, among patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) undergoing catheter ablation for ventricular tachycardia (VT) remains incompletely characterized.

METHODS: We evaluated the association between frailty burden and in-hospital outcomes among patients with HFrEF undergoing VT ablation using the Nationwide Readmissions Database. Frailty was defined using the validated Johns Hopkins Adjusted Clinical Groups (ACG) frailty indicator. Cumulative frailty burden was quantified as the number of domains (range: 0-10). Multivariable logistic regression was used to assess associations with outcomes, and in-hospital mortality probabilities were estimated across increasing frailty burden.

RESULTS: Among 17,367 hospitalizations for VT ablation in patients with HFrEF, 7.4% were classified as frail. Frailty was independently associated with higher in-hospital mortality (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 1.59; 95% CI, 1.19-2.13; p<0.001), and increased complication rates. Frail patients had higher 30-day (13.6% vs. 9.1%) and 90-day (33.7% vs. 28.1%) readmission rates compared with non-frail patients. Frailty burden demonstrated a graded association with in-hospital mortality, with estimated mortality increasing progressively with each additional frailty domain.

CONCLUSIONS: Frailty is independently associated with worse in-hospital outcomes and higher readmission rates among patients with HFrEF undergoing VT ablation, with a graded increase in risk across increasing frailty domains. These findings suggest that frailty burden may serve as a clinically relevant risk stratification marker in this vulnerable cohort.

AI.tldr: 在HFrEF患者接受VT消融的队列中，衰弱与院内死亡和再入院风险独立相关，且衰弱负担每增加一个领域，院内死亡风险呈梯度上升。
AI.motivation: 衰弱在心血管人群中常见且与不良结局相关，但其在HFrEF患者接受VT导管消融中的预后意义，尤其是分级衰弱负担的影响，尚不完全明确。
AI.method: 基于全国再入院数据库的回顾性队列研究，纳入17,367例HFrEF患者VT消融住院记录。衰弱采用经验证的Johns Hopkins ACG衰弱指标定义，衰弱负担以领域数（0-10）量化。主要终点为院内结局（院内死亡、并发症），次要终点为30天和90天再入院。采用多变量logistic回归评估关联，并估计不同衰弱负担下的院内死亡概率。
AI.result: 7.4%患者被归类为衰弱。衰弱与院内死亡独立相关（aOR 1.59；95% CI 1.19-2.13；p<0.001），并增加并发症发生率。衰弱患者30天再入院率13.6% vs 9.1%，90天再入院率33.7% vs 28.1%，均高于非衰弱患者。衰弱负担与院内死亡呈梯度关联，每增加一个衰弱领域，估计死亡率逐步上升。
AI.conclusion: 衰弱是HFrEF患者VT消融后院内不良结局和再入院的独立危险因素，且风险随衰弱领域数增加而梯度上升。衰弱负担可作为该脆弱人群的临床风险分层标志，但摘要未报告具体并发症类型及多变量模型中再入院的校正效应量，需进一步研究验证。

结论：在接受VT消融的HFrEF患者中，衰弱与较差的院内结局和较高的再入院率独立相关，且风险随衰弱域的增加呈分级升高。这些发现提示，衰弱负担可能作为这一脆弱队列中具有临床相关性的风险分层标志物。

title: Cardiovascular Manifestations of Lyme Disease.
summary: Lyme disease is a tick-borne zoonosis caused by Borrelia burgdorferi that can involve multiple organ systems, including the cardiovascular (CV) system, noted in ~1-10% of untreated patients. This can produce atrioventricular (AV) or bundle branch block, atrial fibrillation, and myopericarditis in the acute phase, and dilated cardiomyopathy in the chronic phase. Myocardial involvement may lead to ventricular tachyarrhythmias and sudden death. AV block is reported in ~90% of cases, and in 30-60% of cases, it may necessitate cardiac pacing, at least temporarily, as most cases of high-degree AV blocks resolve with antibiotic therapy within 1 week. Occasionally, aortic dissection may occur. Although Lyme carditis, in the form of myocarditis, pericarditis, and less often endocarditis, is generally self-limited with early appropriate therapy, there is also the potential for lasting CV sequelae, such as persistent AV block (noted in 90% of cases), dilated cardiomyopathy and heart failure, and the rare occurrence of coronary artery involvement and aneurysmal changes. Patients with Lyme disease should receive oral tetracycline or penicillin, which can decrease the incidence of late-stage disease; however, some patients may fail early treatment. In cases of aseptic meningitis and radiculoneuritis, IV penicillin will be needed. As Lyme disease has now replaced syphilis as the "Great Imitator," physicians should be at vigilance for the disease, especially in endemic areas, and be familiarized with the particular skin rash of erythema chronicum migrans, an expanding skin lesion with the characteristic "bull's-eye" appearance patch with a center of clear skin and a distinct peripheral outer erythematous ring.

title: Leveraging AI-ECG Technology for Early Notification and Tracking of AF Development (LATENT): A Randomized Controlled Trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Electrocardiographic analysis aided by artificial intelligence (AI) may identify atrial electrical vulnerability during sinus rhythm. The objective of this study was to determine whether AI-enabled ECG (AI-ECG) is effective for detecting atrial fibrillation (AF), atrial flutter (AFl), or prespecified pre-AF atrial findings in a randomized trial.

METHODS: In this single-center, open-label trial, 14 665 adults 40 to 85 years of age without previous AF/AFl were randomized to an AI-ECG-guided strategy or usual care. Participants randomized to AI-ECG who were then identified by AI as having a high-risk sinus-rhythm ECG in the preceding year were offered Holter monitoring for ≤7 days. Each monitored high-risk intervention participant was paired with an age- and sex-matched control selected before control ECGs underwent AI analysis. Matched controls received identical monitoring to reduce ascertainment bias. Reporting cardiologists were blinded to AI results and randomized assignment. The primary outcome was a composite of newly detected AF, AFl, or pre-AF atrial findings within 90 days. Pre-AF atrial findings comprised frequent premature atrial complexes, short runs of premature atrial complexes, or nonsustained AF/AFl.

RESULTS: Among 7337 intervention and 7328 control participants, 84 (1.1%) and 78 (1.1%), respectively, were classified as high risk. Of the 84 high-risk intervention participants, 48 (57.1%) underwent monitoring, as did 48 matched controls. The primary outcome occurred in 54 intervention participants (0.74%) versus 35 control participants (0.48%; odds ratio, 1.54 [95% CI, 1.01-2.37]; P=0.046). Hypothetical reclassification of 1 intervention event to a nonevent changed the primary analysis P value to 0.057. AF/AFl detection (0.3% versus 0.2%) and antiarrhythmic therapy initiation at 180 days (2.3% versus 2.4%) did not differ significantly between the intervention and control groups. Participant-reported monitoring-related adverse events, including skin reactions and discomfort, occurred in 22.9% of monitored intervention participants versus 18.8% of matched controls.

However, these findings were fragile statistically and sensitive to reclassification of 1 event. LATENT (Leveraging AI-ECG Technology for Early Notification and Tracking of AF Development) demonstrates the clinical application of AI-ECG risk stratification to guide targeted rhythm surveillance, providing a foundation for larger trials evaluating its impact on patient outcomes.

title: Stage 3 acute kidney injury secondary to haemolysis after high-burden pulsed field ablation in a patient with normal baseline renal function: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) causes intravascular haemolysis via irreversible electroporation of erythrocytes. Clinically significant acute kidney injury (AKI) has been reported predominantly in patients with pre-existing chronic kidney disease. However, the relationship between pulse burden and haemolysis-induced renal injury in patients with normal baseline renal function remains incompletely characterized.

CASE SUMMARY: A 76-year-old woman with persistent atrial fibrillation and normal baseline renal function [creatinine 89 µmol/L (normal: 44-80 µmol/L); estimated glomerular filtration rate >60 mL/min/1.73m2] underwent high-burden PFA (72 pulses; Farawave™, Boston Scientific) over a 75-min procedure including all four pulmonary veins, left atrial roof, and posterior wall. Within 48 h, she developed haemoglobinuria, a haemoglobin fall from 132 to 83 g/L (normal: 120-160 g/L), lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) 597 U/L (normal: 135-214 U/L), and undetectable haptoglobin (normal: 0.3-2.0 g/L). Creatinine peaked at 720 µmol/L (KDIGO Stage 3 AKI). Serial LDH declined to 304 U/L by Day 8 of admission, consistent with haemolytic resolution. No intraoperative contrast was used; alternative contributors to AKI, including contrast nephropathy and nephrotoxic medications, were excluded. Full renal recovery was achieved with intravenous hydration and urinary alkalinization (discharge creatinine: 112 µmol/L, Day 17).

DISCUSSION: Haemolysis-induced pigment nephropathy may cause severe AKI after high-burden PFA, even in patients with normal baseline renal function. When ablation extends beyond pulmonary vein isolation, periprocedural intravenous hydration and early post-procedural urine inspection may be considered; prompt hydration with urinary alkalinization can achieve full renal recovery.

title: Efficacy and safety of conscious/deep sedation versus general anesthesia in pulsed field ablation for atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has emerged as a promising therapy for atrial fibrillation. While general anesthesia (GA) is the standard to ensure catheter stability, using conscious or deep sedation (CS/DS) to streamline workflows is gaining interest. However, whether CS/DS provides comparable safety and efficacy to GA remains controversial and has lacked systematic evaluation.

OBJECTIVES: To compare the clinical efficacy and safety of PFA for atrial fibrillation under GA vs. CS/DS.

METHODS: A literature search was conducted in PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Embase from inception to April 9, 2026. Studies were selected using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. The comparison of GA and CS/DS during PFA focused on the following clinical outcomes: procedural time, left atrial dwell time, fluoroscopy time, pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) success rate, and adverse event incidence. Heterogeneity was assessed with the I² statistic and Cochran's Q test; sensitivity analysis was performed if heterogeneity was high. Publication bias was evaluated using funnel plots and Egger's test.

RESULTS: Ten studies involving 3,692 atrial fibrillation patients were included. Compared to GA, CS/DS significantly shortened overall procedural time (WMD: -7.73 min, random-effects; 95% CI: -14.17 to -1.29; P = 0.019). However, there were no significant differences between the groups in left atrial dwell time (WMD: -2.59 min, random-effects; 95% CI: -9.74 to 4.57), fluoroscopy time (WMD: -2.52 min, random-effects; 95% CI: -5.31 to 0.28), acute PVI success (RR: 1.00, fixed-effects; 95% CI: 0.98 to 1.03), or major adverse events (RR: 1.57, fixed-effects; 95% CI: 0.81 to 3.05). CS/DS showed a borderline trend toward fewer minor adverse events (RR: 0.61, fixed-effects; 95% CI: 0.37 to 1.01; P = 0.053).

CONCLUSION: In PFA for AF, CS/DS was associated with reduced overall procedural time compared with GA, while maintaining comparable acute PVI success rates and safety profiles. However, large-scale randomized controlled trials are still needed to confirm these findings.

title: Cardiac electrophysiology procedures must be performed exclusively by trained electrophysiologists: A statement from the Heart Rhythm Society and Heart Rhythm Advocates.
summary: The exponential growth of clinical cardiac electrophysiology (CCEP) as a subspecialty has created an important unresolved question in contemporary cardiovascular medicine: Who is qualified to perform electrophysiology (EP) procedures? As nonelectrophysiologists increasingly perform procedures that require the nuanced expertise of a trained or board-certified CCEP (eg, permanent pacemaker implantation, implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation, cardiac resynchronization therapy, and transvenous lead extraction), the consequences for patient safety, procedural outcomes, and health system efficiency have become impossible to ignore. This article presents a comprehensive, evidence-based argument that cardiac EP procedures must be performed exclusively by physicians who have completed accredited fellowship training in CCEP. We draw upon peer-reviewed outcome data, guideline-derived training standards from the Heart Rhythm Society, the American College of Cardiology, and American Heart Association, including the newly published 2026 American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association/Heart Rhythm Society Advanced Training Statement on Clinical Cardiac Electrophysiology, as well as registry analyses spanning hundreds of thousands of patients to substantiate our position. The risks associated with suboptimal operator training are not theoretical; they are measurable, costly, and potentially fatal. The evidence presented demonstrates that operator specialization in EP is among the most powerful independent predictors of procedural safety and long-term outcomes and can be as important as institutional volume in many analyses. We call upon hospital credentialing committees, national medical societies, payers, regulatory bodies, and policymakers worldwide to establish and enforce a definitive standard: only trained CCEPs should implant and manage cardiac implantable electronic devices, perform catheter ablation procedures, execute transvenous lead extraction, and conduct formal EP studies.

AI.tldr: 心脏电生理手术必须由完成认证培训的电生理医生施行，操作者专业化是手术安全与长期结局的最强独立预测因素之一。

AI.method: 本文为心脏节律学会和心脏节律倡导者发布的立场声明，基于循证论证。研究整合了同行评议的结局数据、心脏节律学会/美国心脏病学会/美国心脏协会的指南衍生培训标准（包括新发布的2026年高级培训声明）以及涵盖数十万患者的注册分析，论证电生理手术必须仅由完成认证专科培训的医生施行。摘要未报告具体的样本量、终点定义和统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。声明指出，操作者培训不足相关的风险是可测量、代价高昂且可能致命的；证据表明，电生理操作者专业化是手术安全和长期结局最强的独立预测因素之一，在许多分析中其重要性可与机构手术量相当。
AI.conclusion: 声明呼吁医院资格认证委员会、国家医学会、支付方、监管机构和政策制定者建立并执行明确标准：只有经过培训的临床心脏电生理医生才能植入和管理心脏植入式电子装置、施行导管消融、经静脉导线拔除和正式电生理检查。该立场对电生理实践具有重要影响，但摘要未报告原始研究的具体数据，结论主要基于证据整合和专家共识。

summary_zh: 临床心脏电生理（CCEP）作为一门亚专科的指数级增长，在当代心血管医学中提出了一个重要且未解决的问题：谁有资格执行电生理（EP）手术？随着非电生理医生越来越多地执行需要训练有素或委员会认证的CCEP医生细致专业技能的手术（例如，永久起搏器植入、植入式心律转复除颤器植入、心脏再同步治疗和经静脉导线拔除），对患者安全、手术结局和卫生系统效率的影响已不容忽视。本文提出一个全面的、基于证据的论点，即心脏EP手术必须仅由已完成CCEP认证专科培训的医生执行。我们借鉴了同行评审的结局数据、来自心律学会、美国心脏病学会和美国心脏协会的指南衍生培训标准，包括新发布的2026年美国心脏病学会/美国心脏协会/心律学会临床心脏电生理高级培训声明，以及涵盖数十万患者的注册分析来证实我们的立场。与操作者培训不足相关的风险不是理论上的；它们是可测量的、代价高昂的，并且可能致命。所呈现的证据表明，EP操作者专业化是手术安全性和长期结局最有力的独立预测因素之一，在许多分析中可能与机构手术量同等重要。我们呼吁医院资格认证委员会、国家医学会、支付方、监管机构和全球政策制定者建立并执行一个明确的标准：只有经过培训的CCEP医生才应植入和管理心脏植入式电子设备、执行导管消融手术、进行经静脉导线拔除和开展正式EP检查。

title: Sepsis-associated atrial fibrillation: Current insights and research priorities for standardized care.
summary: Sepsis-associated atrial fibrillation (SAAF) is a common but serious complication in critically ill patients that is characterized by new-onset atrial fibrillation (AF) during sepsis. This secondary type of arrhythmia typically resolves with sepsis treatment but is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, including prolonged hospital stays, high recurrence rates of AF, and increased risks of heart failure, stroke, and short-term and long-term mortality. In contrast to primary AF, no standardized guidelines have been established for SAAF. To support the development of evidence-based protocols, we conducted a comprehensive review to synthesize the current knowledge of SAAF. Here, we highlight the definition, incidence, and risk factors of SAAF and distinguish it from primary AF and other types of secondary AF, including postoperative and post-myocardial infarction AF. We also describe the multifactorial pathophysiologic mechanisms of SAAF involving systemic inflammation, cytokine release, autonomic dysfunction, myocardial injury, and hemodynamic stress. Key outcomes of patients with SAAF and other types of secondary AF are compared, including in-hospital mortality, long-term AF recurrence, and stroke risk. Furthermore, we discuss various management strategies for SAAF, including methods of rhythm control and rate control in patients with SAAF. Anticoagulation recommendations and challenges for patients with SAAF are highlighted, particularly with respect to thrombotic risk, bleeding risk, and anticoagulation use. We propose a process for anticoagulation decisions in SAAF, which are challenging due to the dynamic interplay between sepsis-induced coagulopathy and thromboembolic risk. Finally, we provide a summary of future research priorities to support large-scale, multicenter trials to define evidence-based protocols that are critical for improving outcomes in this high-risk population.

AI.tldr: 脓毒症相关房颤是脓毒症期间新发的继发性房颤，显著增加住院时间、复发、心衰、卒中及短期和长期死亡风险，但目前尚无标准化指南，亟需多中心试验建立循证方案。
AI.motivation: 脓毒症相关房颤（SAAF）是危重症患者常见而严重的并发症，与不良预后密切相关，但与原发性房颤不同，SAAF 尚无标准化指南，临床管理缺乏循证依据，因此需要系统梳理现有证据以支持规范化诊疗方案的制定。
AI.method: 本文为综合性综述，非原始研究，摘要未报告样本量与统计方法。综述内容涵盖 SAAF 的定义、发生率与危险因素，并将其与原发性房颤及术后房颤、心肌梗死后房颤等其他继发性房颤相区分；阐述其多因素病理生理机制（全身炎症、细胞因子释放、自主神经功能障碍、心肌损伤、血流动力学应激）；比较 SAAF 与其他继发性房颤在院内死亡、长期房颤复发及卒中风险等结局上的差异；讨论节律控制与心率控制策略、抗凝建议及血栓与出血风险的挑战，并提出 SAAF 抗凝决策流程；最后总结未来研究优先方向。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。综述指出 SAAF 通常随脓毒症治疗而缓解，但仍与住院时间延长、房颤高复发率以及心衰、卒中、短期和长期死亡风险增加相关；抗凝决策因脓毒症所致凝血病与血栓栓塞风险之间的动态相互作用而具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: SAAF 是区别于原发性房颤的独立临床实体，预后不良且管理缺乏标准。临床意义在于需建立针对 SAAF 的节律/心率控制与个体化抗凝决策路径，并推动大规模多中心试验以形成循证方案；局限性在于本文为综述，未提供原始数据，相关推荐尚缺乏高质量证据支持。

summary_zh: 脓毒症相关心房颤动（SAAF）是危重症患者中常见但严重的并发症，其特征是在脓毒症期间新发心房颤动（AF）。这种继发性心律失常通常随脓毒症治疗而缓解，但与显著的发病率和死亡率相关，包括住院时间延长、AF高复发率以及心力衰竭、卒中和短期及长期死亡风险增加。与原发性AF不同，SAAF尚未建立标准化指南。为支持循证方案的制定，我们进行了一项全面综述，以综合当前关于SAAF的知识。在此，我们重点介绍SAAF的定义、发病率和危险因素，并将其与原发性AF及其他类型的继发性AF（包括术后和心肌梗死后AF）相区分。我们还描述了SAAF的多因素病理生理机制，涉及全身性炎症、细胞因子释放、自主神经功能障碍、心肌损伤和血流动力学应激。比较了SAAF和其他类型继发性AF患者的关键结局，包括院内死亡率、长期AF复发和卒中风险。此外，我们讨论了SAAF的各种管理策略，包括SAAF患者节律控制和心率控制的方法。强调了SAAF患者的抗凝建议和挑战，特别是在血栓风险、出血风险和抗凝使用方面。我们提出了SAAF抗凝决策的流程，由于脓毒症诱导的凝血病与血栓栓塞风险之间的动态相互作用，这一决策具有挑战性。最后，我们总结了未来的研究重点，以支持大规模、多中心试验，从而制定循证方案，这对于改善这一高危人群的结局至关重要。

title: Understanding left atrial pressure: basic physiology, hemodynamics, and current echocardiographic assessment.
summary: Left atrial pressure (LAP) is a major determinant of pulmonary congestion and a key hemodynamic parameter in patients with heart failure and atrial fibrillation. LAP has traditionally been regarded as a surrogate of left ventricular (LV) filling pressure. However, growing evidence indicates that LAP reflects integrated interactions between left atrial (LA) mechanics, LV diastolic and systolic function, and extrinsic mechanical restraints throughout the cardiac cycle. Understanding the physiological basis of the LAP waveform provides important insights into the LA booster pump, reservoir, and conduit functions, as well as LA-LV interactions. Recent advances in echocardiography have expanded the noninvasive assessment of LAP beyond conventional Doppler indices. Contemporary approaches integrate the values of transmitral flow, mitral annular velocity, pulmonary venous flow, LA volume, and LA reservoir strain to provide a more comprehensive noninvasive assessment of LAP. In particular, LA reservoir strain has emerged as a promising marker of LAP and atrial mechanics. Additionally, exercise stress echocardiography and preload stress testing can reveal occult abnormalities in LAP responses that are not apparent at rest, particularly in patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. Abnormal LAP also plays a central role in the pathophysiology of atrial fibrillation, atrial remodeling, and stiff LA physiology. This review summarizes the physiological determinants of LAP, the hemodynamic significance of the LAP waveform, and contemporary echocardiographic approaches for the assessment of LAP, and the impact of extrinsic mechanical restraints on LAP, with particular emphasis on the clinical relevance of LA-LV interactions in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and atrial fibrillation.

AI.tldr: 本综述指出左房压（LAP）并非单纯左室充盈压的替代指标，而是反映左房力学、左室收缩舒张功能与心外机械约束在心动周期中整合作用的关键血流动力学参数，并提出以左房储器应变等超声新指标综合无创评估LAP。
AI.motivation: LAP是肺淤血的主要决定因素，也是心衰与房颤患者的重要血流动力学指标。既往将LAP简单视为左室充盈压的替代，但越来越多证据显示其受左房力学、左室功能及心外机械约束共同影响；传统多普勒指标对LAP的无创评估存在不足，尤其射血分数保留的心衰（HFpEF）患者静息状态下LAP异常常被漏诊，亟需更全面的评估策略。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，无原始研究人群与样本量（摘要未报告）。文章系统总结LAP的生理决定因素、LAP波形的血流动力学意义及当代超声评估方法，涵盖经二尖瓣血流、二尖瓣环速度、肺静脉血流、左房容积与左房储器应变等指标的综合应用，并讨论运动负荷超声与容量负荷试验对隐匿性LAP异常的揭示作用，以及心外机械约束对LAP的影响。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。综述要点包括：LAP波形可反映左房助力泵、储器与管道功能及左房-左室交互；左房储器应变已成为评估LAP与心房力学的有前景指标；运动负荷超声与容量负荷试验可发现静息时未显现的LAP反应异常，尤其在HFpEF患者中；LAP异常在房颤、心房重构与僵硬左房生理中居核心地位。
AI.conclusion: LAP应被理解为左房力学、左室功能与心外约束整合后的血流动力学指标，而非左室充盈压的简单替代。临床应采用整合经二尖瓣血流、二尖瓣环速度、肺静脉血流、左房容积与左房储器应变的综合超声策略，并结合负荷试验识别HFpEF与房颤患者的隐匿性LAP异常。本文为综述，未提供原始数据验证上述策略的预后价值，相关结论仍需前瞻性研究证实。

summary_zh: 左心房压力（LAP）是肺淤血的主要决定因素，也是心力衰竭和心房颤动患者的关键血流动力学参数。LAP传统上被视为左心室（LV）充盈压的替代指标。然而，越来越多的证据表明，LAP反映了整个心动周期中左心房（LA）力学、LV舒张和收缩功能以及外在机械约束之间的综合相互作用。理解LAP波形的生理基础为LA助力泵、储存器和管道功能以及LA-LV相互作用提供了重要见解。超声心动图的最新进展已将LAP的无创评估扩展到传统多普勒指标之外。当代方法整合了经二尖瓣血流、二尖瓣环速度、肺静脉血流、LA容积和LA储存器应变的值，以提供更全面的LAP无创评估。特别是，LA储存器应变已成为LAP和心房力学的有前景的标志物。此外，运动负荷超声心动图和前负荷负荷试验可以揭示静息时不明显的LAP反应异常，特别是在射血分数保留的心力衰竭患者中。异常的LAP还在心房颤动、心房重构和僵硬LA生理的病理生理学中发挥核心作用。本综述总结了LAP的生理决定因素、LAP波形的血流动力学意义、当代超声心动图评估LAP的方法以及外在机械约束对LAP的影响，特别强调了射血分数保留的心力衰竭和心房颤动中LA-LV相互作用的临床相关性。

title: Clinical efficacy of minimally invasive cardiac valve surgery concomitant with radiofrequency ablation for atrial fibrillation: a single-center retrospective study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Concomitant atrial fibrillation (AF) and valvular heart disease (VHD) present complex clinical challenges. Standard radiofrequency ablation (RFA) combined with valve surgery via median sternotomy offers robust rhythm correction but causes significant surgical trauma. Minimally invasive cardiac valve surgery with concomitant RFA (MICVS-RFA) is a promising strategy, but clinical data regarding its comprehensive safety, efficacy, and predictive risk factors for AF recurrence remain scarce. Thus, we aimed to evaluate the safety and clinical efficacy of MICVS-RFA and to develop an exploratory prognostic model for risk stratification.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 146 patients with concomitant VHD and AF who underwent MICVS-RFA between April 1, 2020, and August 1, 2025. Surgical cohorts included mitral valve replacement (MVR; n=34), mitral valve repair (MVr; n=19), MVR combined with tricuspid valve repair (MVR + TVr; n=57), and MVr combined with tricuspid valve repair (MVr + TVr; n=36). Pre-operative predictors for post-operative AF recurrence were identified using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and elastic net regularization integrated within a multiple imputation framework to develop an exploratory model. Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) improvements were assessed dynamically.

RESULTS: Procedural success was achieved in all 146 patients, with an overall 30-day freedom from recurrent AF (FFAF) rate of 89.7% and no observed major adverse events (stroke, bleeding, or thromboembolism) within the first post-operative month. Length of stay (LOS) showed no statistical differences among surgical cohorts (P=0.71). Logistic regression modeling identified pre-operative metoprolol usage as associated with lower odds of AF recurrence [odds ratio (OR) =0.17; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.04-0.62], while pre-operative pulmonary hypertension (PH) showed a non-significant association with higher odds of AF recurrence (OR =3.07; 95% CI: 0.67-14.10). The predictive model showed moderate discrimination [bootstrap-corrected area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) =0.773] and apparent calibration. Patients with baseline LVEF <55% experienced superior functional recovery compared to those with LVEF ≥55% (ΔLVEF: 13.07%±2.56% vs. 0.18%±0.80%, P<0.001).

CONCLUSIONS: MICVS-RFA was a feasible "dual minimally invasive" strategy that permits concomitant treatment of valvular pathology and AF through a minimally invasive approach, minimizing perioperative trauma. Comparative and long-term effects require further study.

AI.tldr: 微创瓣膜手术联合射频消融治疗房颤安全可行，30天无复发率89.7%，术前美托洛尔使用与复发风险降低相关，基线LVEF<55%者功能恢复更佳。
AI.motivation: 房颤合并瓣膜性心脏病临床处理复杂，标准正中开胸瓣膜手术联合射频消融虽节律控制可靠但创伤大；微创瓣膜手术联合射频消融（MICVS-RFA）的安全性、疗效及房颤复发预测因素数据匮乏，本研究旨在评估其安全性和临床疗效并探索预后模型。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2020年4月1日至2025年8月1日接受MICVS-RFA的146例瓣膜性心脏病合并房颤患者，手术方式包括二尖瓣置换（MVR，n=34）、二尖瓣修复（MVr，n=19）、MVR+三尖瓣修复（n=57）、MVr+三尖瓣修复（n=36）。采用LASSO和弹性网正则化结合多重插补框架筛选术前房颤复发预测因素并构建探索性模型，动态评估左心室射血分数（LVEF）改善情况。
AI.result: 全部146例手术成功，总体30天无房颤复发（FFAF）率为89.7%，术后首月未观察到主要不良事件（卒中、出血或血栓栓塞）。各手术组间住院时间无统计学差异（P=0.71）。Logistic回归显示术前使用美托洛尔与较低的房颤复发风险相关（OR=0.17；95%CI：0.04-0.62），术前肺动脉高压与较高的复发风险相关但无统计学意义（OR=3.07；95%CI：0.67-14.10）。预测模型具有中等区分度（bootstrap校正AUC=0.773）和表观校准度。基线LVEF<55%的患者较LVEF≥55%者功能恢复更优（ΔLVEF：13.07%±2.56% vs. 0.18%±0.80%，P<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: MICVS-RFA是一种可行的“双微创”策略，可经微创途径同期处理瓣膜病变和房颤，减少围术期创伤；术前美托洛尔使用可能与降低房颤复发风险相关，基线LVEF降低者功能恢复更显著。但本研究为单中心回顾性研究，缺乏对照和长期随访数据，比较性和长期疗效需进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）合并瓣膜性心脏病（VHD）构成复杂的临床挑战。标准射频消融（RFA）联合经胸骨正中切口的瓣膜手术能提供可靠的心律矫正，但会造成显著的手术创伤。微创心脏瓣膜手术联合RFA（MICVS-RFA）是一种有前景的策略，但关于其综合安全性、有效性及AF复发的预测性危险因素的临床数据仍然匮乏。因此，我们旨在评估MICVS-RFA的安全性和临床疗效，并开发一个探索性预后模型用于风险分层。

方法：我们回顾性分析了2020年4月1日至2025年8月1日期间接受MICVS-RFA的146例VHD合并AF患者。手术队列包括二尖瓣置换术（MVR；n=34）、二尖瓣修复术（MVr；n=19）、MVR联合三尖瓣修复术（MVR + TVr；n=57）以及MVr联合三尖瓣修复术（MVr + TVr；n=36）。使用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）和弹性网络正则化整合于多重插补框架内，识别术后AF复发的术前预测因素，以开发探索性模型。动态评估左心室射血分数（LVEF）的改善情况。

结果：所有146例患者均获得手术成功，总体30天无复发性AF（FFAF）率为89.7%，术后第一个月内未观察到主要不良事件（卒中、出血或血栓栓塞）。住院时间（LOS）在各手术队列间无统计学差异（P=0.71）。逻辑回归模型识别出术前使用美托洛尔与较低的AF复发几率相关[比值比（OR）=0.17；95%置信区间（CI）：0.04-0.62]，而术前肺动脉高压（PH）与较高的AF复发几率呈非显著性关联（OR=3.07；95% CI：0.67-14.10）。预测模型显示出中等区分度[经Bootstrap校正的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）=0.773]和表观校准度。基线LVEF <55%的患者与LVEF ≥55%的患者相比，功能恢复更优（ΔLVEF：13.07%±2.56% vs. 0.18%±0.80%，P<0.001）。

结论：MICVS-RFA是一种可行的“双微创”策略，允许通过微创途径同时治疗瓣膜病变和AF，最大限度地减少围手术期创伤。比较性和长期效果需要进一步研究。

title: The ligament of Marshall as a therapeutic target in atrial fibrillation: from anatomy to catheter-based and surgical management-a narrative review.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Long regarded as an inconsequential embryological remnant, the ligament of Marshall (LOM) is now recognized as a treatable component of the atrial fibrillation (AF) substrate. This review synthesizes the anatomical, electrophysiological and clinical evidence behind that shift and compares the two routes to the LOM: percutaneous retrograde ethanol infusion into the vein of Marshall (EIVOM) during catheter ablation, and direct division during thoracoscopic surgery. Both act on the same epicardial structure; only the route of access differs.

METHODS: A structured literature search of PubMed, Embase and Web of Science covered the embryology, anatomy, histology and electrophysiology of the LOM and clinical studies of both routes. Two authors screened and selected records independently. Given the heterogeneity of study designs, findings were synthesized narratively.

KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: The LOM is a neuro-muscular remnant of the embryonic left superior vena cava that contributes to AF through three mechanisms: triggers arising from insulated myocardial "Marshall bundles", autonomic modulation via adjacent ganglionated plexi, and preferential conduction across the mitral isthmus. Five randomized trials of EIVOM-based strategies have enrolled more than 1,100 patients; pooled analysis shows improved 12-month freedom from any atrial arrhythmia (risk ratio 1.16, 95% confidence interval: 1.04-1.29; number needed to treat 10) and less repeat ablation, without excess major complications (2.5% vs. 2.8%) but with more overall complications and longer fluoroscopy. Crucially, no trial has tested ethanol infusion in isolation; the observed benefit reflects composite lesion sets. Thoracoscopic division interrupts the entire ligament independent of venous anatomy but has never been a randomized variable; randomized evidence for thoracoscopic and hybrid strategies overall ranges from neutral (CASA-AF) to positive (CONVERGE, HARTCAP-AF). Guidelines recognize both as options in selected patients without mandating routine LOM division.

CONCLUSIONS: The LOM is a reproducible, anatomically defined target reachable percutaneously or by surgical division within a comprehensive AF ablation strategy. The supporting evidence is markedly asymmetric: randomized data exist for EIVOM-based strategies but never for ethanol infusion alone, none at all for surgical division, and the two routes have never been compared head-to-head. Its incremental benefit beyond pulmonary vein and posterior wall isolation remains undefined.

summary_zh:
背景与目的：Marshall韧带（ligament of Marshall, LOM）长期被视为无足轻重的胚胎学残留物，现已被认为是心房颤动（atrial fibrillation, AF）基质中可治疗的一个组成部分。本综述综合了支持这一转变的解剖学、电生理学和临床证据，并比较了到达LOM的两条途径：导管消融术中经皮逆行无水乙醇输注入Marshall静脉（ethanol infusion into the vein of Marshall, EIVOM），以及胸腔镜手术中的直接离断。两者作用于相同的心外膜结构，仅入路不同。

方法：对PubMed、Embase和Web of Science进行了结构化文献检索，涵盖LOM的胚胎学、解剖学、组织学和电生理学以及两种途径的临床研究。两位作者独立筛选和选择文献。鉴于研究设计的异质性，结果以叙述性方式综合。

关键内容与发现：LOM是胚胎期左上腔静脉的神经肌肉残留物，通过三种机制参与AF：起源于绝缘心肌“Marshall束”的触发灶、通过邻近神经节丛的自主神经调节，以及跨二尖瓣峡部的优先传导。五项基于EIVOM策略的随机试验已纳入超过1,100例患者；汇总分析显示12个月无任何房性心律失常的生存率改善（风险比1.16，95%置信区间：1.04-1.29；需治疗人数10），重复消融减少，无过多主要并发症（2.5% vs. 2.8%），但总体并发症更多且透视时间更长。关键的是，尚无试验单独测试乙醇输注；观察到的获益反映的是复合消融 lesion 集。胸腔镜离断可中断整个韧带，不依赖于静脉解剖，但从未作为随机变量；胸腔镜和杂交策略的随机证据总体范围从中性（CASA-AF）到阳性（CONVERGE、HARTCAP-AF）。指南将两者均视为特定患者的选择，但未强制要求常规LOM离断。

结论：LOM是一个可重复、解剖学定义明确的靶点，可在综合AF消融策略中经皮或通过手术离断到达。支持证据明显不对称：基于EIVOM策略存在随机数据，但从未有单独乙醇输注的随机数据，手术离断则完全没有，且两种途径从未进行过头对头比较。其在肺静脉和後壁隔离之外的增量获益仍未明确。

title: Single-nucleus cNMF identifies a six-gene classifier predictive of atrial fibrillation recurrence.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) reflects intertwined immune-stromal remodeling, yet compact and generalizable diagnostic markers remain limited. Left-atrial single-nucleus RNA-seq was analyzed using SCTransform, PCA/UMAP, and lineage-aware cNMF (K = 4-8) to define transcriptional programs. Immune-related genes were filtered via ImmPort and analyzed using clusterProfiler, ReactomePA, and Enrichr. A 16-model benchmarking framework integrating stepwise GLM and LASSO identified a six-gene panel (EXT1, ATG7, PTPRC, MERTK, IRAK3, RORA). Immune infiltration was estimated using CIBERSORTx, and clinical outcomes were assessed using Andersen-Gill and Fine-Gray models. Experimental validation included RT-qPCR, siRNA-mediated knockdown, wound-healing, colony formation, and immunofluorescence assays in AF-mimicking atrial fibroblasts. Docking-guided drug screening and gene-drug interaction assays were performed to evaluate therapeutic targeting. Luciferase assays confirmed miRNA regulation. cNMF revealed lineage-restricted programs enriched in TGF-β, interferon-α, and inflammatory signaling, with macrophage and T cell activation as dominant features. The six-gene panel achieved AUROC = 0.583 (AUPRC = 0.627) with consistent external validation. RT-qPCR confirmed upregulation of all genes under AF-like conditions. Functional assays demonstrated that MERTK and IRAK3 regulate fibroblast activation, migration, proliferation, and extracellular matrix deposition, with MERTK exerting the strongest effect. Docking-guided screening identified MK-2461 as a potent inhibitor of fibrotic remodeling, significantly reducing gene expression, wound healing, and α-SMA/collagen accumulation. Lack of additive effects with MERTK knockdown indicated target dependency. hsa-miR-155-5p directly repressed all six genes. Persistent AF showed increased recurrence and progression risk. This integrative framework links immune-stromal remodeling, miRNA regulation, functional fibroblast activation, and therapeutic targeting, identifying MERTK as a key driver and actionable target in AF progression.

AI.tldr: 基于左房单核RNA测序与cNMF构建的六基因组合（EXT1、ATG7、PTPRC、MERTK、IRAK3、RORA）对房颤复发的预测效能有限（AUROC 0.583），但MERTK被鉴定为驱动心房纤维化的关键可干预靶点。
AI.motivation: 房颤涉及免疫与基质重构的交互作用，但缺乏简洁、可推广的诊断与预后标志物；既往研究多基于批量测序，难以解析细胞谱系特异的转录程序，且缺少从标志物到功能验证与药物靶向的完整链条。
AI.method: 研究对左房组织行单核RNA-seq，经SCTransform、PCA/UMAP及谱系感知cNMF（K=4-8）定义转录程序，用ImmPort筛选免疫相关基因并行clusterProfiler、ReactomePA、Enrichr富集分析；采用整合逐步GLM与LASSO的16模型基准框架筛选基因组合；CIBERSORTx估计免疫浸润，Andersen-Gill与Fine-Gray模型评估临床结局；在房颤模拟心房成纤维细胞中行RT-qPCR、siRNA敲低、划痕愈合、集落形成与免疫荧光验证，并行对接引导的药物筛选及基因-药物相互作用实验，荧光素酶实验确认miRNA调控。样本量摘要未报告。
AI.result: cNMF显示谱系限制性程序富集于TGF-β、干扰素-α及炎症信号，以巨噬细胞和T细胞活化为主要特征。六基因组合AUROC=0.583、AUPRC=0.627，外部验证结果一致。房颤样条件下六个基因均上调；MERTK与IRAK3调控成纤维细胞活化、迁移、增殖及细胞外基质沉积，其中MERTK作用最强。对接筛选出MK-2461可显著降低基因表达、划痕愈合及α-SMA/胶原蓄积，与MERTK敲低无叠加效应，提示靶点依赖性。hsa-miR-155-5p直接抑制全部六个基因。持续性房颤复发与进展风险升高。
AI.conclusion: 该整合框架将免疫-基质重构、miRNA调控、成纤维细胞功能活化与治疗靶向相连，提示MERTK是房颤进展的关键驱动因子与可干预靶点；但六基因组合的判别效能有限（AUROC 0.583），尚不足以作为临床复发预测工具，且研究以体外验证为主，样本量与临床队列细节摘要未报告，需进一步前瞻性验证。

title: Air Embolism During Cryoballoon Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation Under Different Respiratory Management Strategies.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Coronary air embolism is a rare but potentially fatal complication during catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF). Use of large-bore sheaths, such as those required for balloon-based catheter ablation, in the setting of unstable respiratory control may increase the risk.

METHODS: We retrospectively evaluated consecutive patients who underwent first-time cryoballoon ablation (CBA) for AF from January 2017 to December 2024. Patients were divided into two groups according to respiratory management strategy: adaptive servo-ventilation (ASV, n = 266) and laryngeal mask with mechanical ventilation (LM, n = 225). The incidence of complications was compared, with a primary focus on air embolism.

RESULTS: A total of 491 patients (median age 68 years, 71.3% male) were included. Coronary air embolism occurred in 5 patients (1.9%) in the ASV group and in none of the patients in the LM group (absolute risk difference, 1.9%; 95% CI, -0.1% to 4.3%; p = 0.066). In one patient with coronary air embolism, brain MRI performed on the day of the procedure incidentally revealed an asymptomatic acute cerebral embolic lesion. Other complications included two cases of cardiac tamponade in the ASV group and two cases of transient phrenic nerve palsy in the LM group.

CONCLUSIONS: Coronary air embolism was numerically less frequent in patients undergoing cryoballoon ablation with laryngeal mask ventilation than in those managed with ASV, although the difference did not reach statistical significance. Further prospective studies are warranted to clarify the potential role of respiratory management in procedural safety.

背景：冠状动脉空气栓塞是心房颤动（AF）导管消融过程中罕见但可能致命的并发症。在呼吸控制不稳定的情况下使用大口径鞘管（如基于球囊的导管消融所需的鞘管）可能增加风险。

title: Mapping and Outcome Implications of Left Atrial Low Voltage Regions as Determined by a Novel 122-electrode Spherical Mapping and Ablation Catheter.
summary:
AIMS: A novel 122-electrode spherical mapping/pulsed field ablation (PFA) device is known to effectively ablate atrial fibrillation (AF). The aim of this study is threshold optimization of LVA for the unique geometry of the Globe electrodes and the prognostic association, to evaluate if the extent of low voltage areas could predict recurrence.

METHODS AND RESULTS: The PULSAR study was an IDE trial of 183 patients undergoing first-time paroxysmal AF ablation with one-year outcomes of any atrial arrhythmia. During this study, a subset of patients (n=82) had detailed pre-ablation voltage maps performed with the catheter. Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) was then performed with PFA. Patients were followed with weekly transtelephonic monitoring, ECG, and Holters at 3, 6, and 12 months. Recurrence was defined as any atrial arrhythmia (AA) > 30 seconds.Receiver operator curve (ROC) analysis revealed that a low voltage threshold of 1.0 mV had the highest value (0.735). The percentage LVA surface area resulting from a threshold of 1.0 mV that predicted AA recurrence was 11.6%. Univariate and multivariate analysis revealed the percentage LVA was the strongest predictor of AA recurrence. The 12-month freedom from AA was 84.6% and 52.9% for subjects under and over the low voltage area threshold respectively.

CONCLUSIONS: A voltage threshold of 1.0 mV is proposed as a threshold for defining LVA using the spherical catheter, but a range of approximately 0.5-1.5 mV yielded similar performance. Increased low voltage area in the pre-ablation atrial map was associated with a higher risk of AA recurrence.

AI.tldr: 在首次阵发性房颤脉冲场消融患者中，球形标测导管定义的左房低电压区（阈值1.0 mV）面积占比>11.6%可预测术后房性心律失常复发，12个月无复发率分别为84.6%与52.9%。
AI.motivation: 新型122电极球形标测/脉冲场消融（PFA）装置已用于房颤消融，但其电极几何构型下左房低电压区（LVA）的电压阈值尚未优化，且LVA范围能否预测消融后复发尚不明确。
AI.method: PULSAR研究（IDE试验）纳入183例首次阵发性房颤PFA消融患者，其中82例在消融前用该导管行详细电压标测，随后行肺静脉隔离（PVI）。术后每周经电话心电监测，并在3、6、12个月行动态心电图。复发定义为任何持续>30秒的房性心律失常（AA）。采用ROC分析确定LVA阈值，单因素及多因素分析评估预测因素。
AI.result: ROC分析显示1.0 mV阈值价值最高（AUC 0.735），预测AA复发的LVA面积占比界值为11.6%。单因素及多因素分析均显示LVA百分比是AA复发的最强预测因子。LVA低于与高于阈值的患者12个月无AA生存率分别为84.6%与52.9%。
AI.conclusion: 对于该球形导管，建议以1.0 mV定义LVA（约0.5-1.5 mV范围性能相似）。消融前左房LVA增大与AA复发风险升高相关，提示电压标测可用于风险分层。但本研究为子集分析，样本量有限，阈值需外部验证。

summary_zh:
目的：一种新型的122电极球形标测/脉冲场消融（PFA）装置已知能有效消融心房颤动（AF）。本研究的目的是针对Globe电极的独特几何形状优化LVA的阈值，并探讨其预后关联，以评估低电压区域的范围是否能预测复发。

方法与结果：PULSAR研究是一项IDE试验，纳入183例首次接受阵发性AF消融的患者，随访一年内任何房性心律失常的发生情况。在该研究中，一部分患者（n=82）使用该导管进行了详细的消融前电压标测。随后使用PFA进行肺静脉隔离（PVI）。患者接受每周经电话监测、心电图以及3、6和12个月时的动态心电图随访。复发定义为任何持续时间>30秒的房性心律失常（AA）。受试者工作特征曲线（ROC）分析显示，低电压阈值1.0 mV具有最高值（0.735）。由1.0 mV阈值得出的预测AA复发的LVA表面积百分比为11.6%。单因素和多因素分析显示，LVA百分比是AA复发的最强预测因子。低于和高于低电压区域阈值的受试者12个月无AA生存率分别为84.6%和52.9%。

结论：建议将1.0 mV电压阈值作为使用球形导管定义LVA的阈值，但约0.5-1.5 mV的范围产生了相似的性能。消融前心房标测中低电压区域增加与AA复发风险较高相关。

title: Dyslipidemia management in athletes: A comparative commentary on the 2026 ACC/AHA/Multisociety Guideline and contemporary sports cardiology recommendations.
summary: Coronary artery disease (CAD) is the leading cause of exercise-related sudden cardiac death in athletes older than 35 years, and dyslipidemia is one of its principal modifiable drivers. The 2026 ACC/AHA/Multisociety Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol introduces several advances directly relevant to athletes, including restored LDL-C treatment targets, universal lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] measurement, the PREVENT-ASCVD risk equations, expanded options for selective coronary artery calcium (CAC) scoring, and a more aggressive approach to lipid-lowering therapy (LLT). However, sports cardiology guidelines and consensus statements offer important caveats that must be reconciled with these general-population recommendations: existing risk calculators, including PREVENT, do not reliably estimate cardiovascular risk in athletes, and routine CAC scoring is not recommended in athletes at low calculated risk. This commentary compares and contrasts general-population dyslipidemia recommendations with athlete-specific guidance from contemporary sports cardiology consensus documents, highlights recent evidence on Lp(a), wearable-derived training load, and risk score performance across the physical activity spectrum, and proposes a five-step clinical framework, refined to reflect athlete-specific risk stratification, for dyslipidemia evaluation and management in this population.

AI.tldr: 2026 ACC/AHA 血脂指南与运动心脏病学共识在运动员血脂管理上存在分歧，需个体化整合，本文提出五步临床框架。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉疾病是35岁以上运动员运动相关心源性猝死的主因，血脂异常是其可干预驱动因素。2026 ACC/AHA 指南更新了LDL-C目标、Lp(a)普遍测量、PREVENT风险方程及CAC评分等，但运动心脏病学共识指出这些工具在运动员中可靠性不足，临床亟需协调两类推荐。
AI.method: 本文为比较性评论，非原始研究。系统对比2026 ACC/AHA/Multisociety血胆固醇管理指南与当代运动心脏病学共识文件，聚焦Lp(a)、可穿戴设备训练负荷及风险评分在体力活动谱中的表现，并提出针对运动员的五步临床评估管理框架。摘要未报告样本量、终点及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。关键定性结论：现有风险计算器（含PREVENT）不能可靠估计运动员心血管风险；低计算风险运动员不推荐常规CAC评分；指南恢复LDL-C治疗目标、普遍测量Lp(a)、扩大选择性CAC评分并强化降脂治疗。
AI.conclusion: 运动员血脂管理需在通用指南与运动心脏病学共识间取得平衡，采用反映运动员特异性风险分层的五步框架进行个体化评估与治疗。对电生理实践而言，应关注运动员血脂异常与运动相关猝死风险的关联，但现有证据限于评论层面，缺乏前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 冠状动脉疾病（CAD）是35岁以上运动员运动相关心源性猝死的主要原因，而血脂异常是其主要的可改变驱动因素之一。2026年ACC/AHA/多学会血液胆固醇管理指南引入了与运动员直接相关的若干进展，包括恢复LDL-C治疗目标、普遍测量脂蛋白(a)[Lp(a)]、PREVENT-ASCVD风险方程、选择性冠状动脉钙化（CAC）评分的扩展选项，以及更积极的降脂治疗（LLT）策略。然而，运动心脏病学指南和共识声明提供了重要的注意事项，必须与这些一般人群建议相协调：现有的风险计算器，包括PREVENT，不能可靠地估计运动员的心血管风险，并且对于计算风险低的运动员，不推荐常规进行CAC评分。本评论比较和对比了一般人群血脂异常建议与当代运动心脏病学共识文件中针对运动员的指导，重点介绍了关于Lp(a)、可穿戴设备衍生的训练负荷以及风险评分在整个体力活动谱系中性能的最新证据，并提出了一个五步临床框架，经过细化以反映运动员特定的风险分层，用于该人群的血脂异常评估和管理。

title: Patient-adaptive and clinically interpretable arrhythmia detection from ECG using lightweight hybrid deep learning.
summary: A precise and reliable identification of cardiac arrhythmias from electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is critical for making informed clinical decisions. In this paper, a patient-adaptive and clinically interpretable a hybrid CNN-LSTM model with an attention mechanism is offered as a framework for ECG arrhythmia identification. The proposed framework combines signal preprocessing techniques with domain knowledge-driven morphological and time-frequency features to jointly analyze the waveform patterns and temporal dependencies in noisy ECG signals. In addition to beat-level classification, a composite arrhythmia burden score is also proposed to offer a patient-level summary of arrhythmic activity, and a lightweight patient-specific adaptation method is used to enhance reliability with limited calibration data. Over 99% accuracy and strong sensitivity to ventricular and supraventricular arrhythmias are demonstrated by experimental results employing a rigorous inter-patient methodology on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database. The suggested framework's capacity to generalize on actual clinical datasets is further validated by external validation on the PTB-XL dataset without retraining. The proposed framework is also scalable for cloud-based deployment to enable continuous ECG monitoring, thus emphasizing its potential for practical and patient-centric cardiac care.

AI.tldr: 一种轻量级混合CNN-LSTM注意力模型在MIT-BIH上以严格跨患者方式实现室性与室上性心律失常识别准确率超99%，并在PTB-XL外部验证中无需再训练即可泛化。
AI.motivation: 心电图心律失常的精准识别对临床决策至关重要，但现有自动检测方法在噪声干扰、患者间差异和有限校准数据条件下可靠性不足，且缺乏可解释性与患者层面的心律失常负荷汇总。
AI.method: 研究提出患者自适应、临床可解释的混合CNN-LSTM加注意力机制框架，融合信号预处理与领域知识驱动的形态学及时频特征，联合分析波形模式与时间依赖；除心搏级分类外，构建复合心律失常负荷评分用于患者层面汇总，并采用轻量级患者特异性适配方法在有限校准数据下提升可靠性；在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库上采用严格跨患者方法评估，并在PTB-XL数据集上做无需再训练的外部验证。
AI.result: 在MIT-BIH数据库的严格跨患者实验中，模型准确率超过99%，对室性和室上性心律失常均表现出较强敏感性；在PTB-XL数据集上无需再训练即完成外部验证，显示对真实临床数据集的泛化能力；摘要未报告具体的敏感性、特异度数值及95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在跨患者条件下实现高准确率的心律失常识别并具备外部泛化能力，患者自适应与负荷评分设计有助于患者中心化管理，且支持云端部署以用于连续心电监测；但摘要未报告前瞻性临床验证、具体效应量及外部验证的量化性能，尚需在真实临床环境中进一步确认其可靠性。

summary_zh: 从心电图（ECG）信号中精确、可靠地识别心律失常对于做出明智的临床决策至关重要。本文提出了一种具有注意力机制的患者自适应且临床可解释的混合CNN-LSTM模型，作为ECG心律失常识别的框架。该框架将信号预处理技术与领域知识驱动的形态学和时频特征相结合，以联合分析噪声ECG信号中的波形模式和时间依赖性。除搏动级分类外，还提出了一种复合心律失常负荷评分，以提供患者水平的心律失常活动总结，并采用了一种轻量级的患者特异性自适应方法，以在有限的校准数据下提高可靠性。在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库上采用严格的跨患者方法进行的实验结果表明，其准确率超过99%，对室性和室上性心律失常具有高灵敏度。在PTB-XL数据集上无需重新训练的外部验证进一步证实了该框架在实际临床数据集上的泛化能力。所提出的框架还可扩展至基于云的部署，以实现连续ECG监测，从而强调了其在实用和以患者为中心的心脏护理中的潜力。

title: Fetal Supraventricular Tachycardia Complicated by Hydrops Fetalis: A Case Report of Complete Reversal With Transplacental Flecainide Therapy.
summary: Fetal supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) is the predominant sustained fetal tachyarrhythmia and, when persistent, can progress to tachycardia-induced myocardial dysfunction and nonimmune hydrops fetalis (NIHF), a condition associated with substantial perinatal morbidity and mortality. Although digoxin has historically served as first-line therapy, flecainide demonstrates superior transplacental bioavailability and higher cardioversion rates in hydropic fetuses, in whom placental edema may impair digoxin transfer. We report a case of fetal SVT complicated by hydrops fetalis at 30 weeks' gestation that achieved complete intrauterine reversal following maternal flecainide therapy. A 31-year-old woman was referred after fetal echocardiography demonstrated SVT with a ventricular rate of approximately 300 beats per minute and 1:1 atrioventricular conduction, alongside fetal ascites and pericardial effusion consistent with NIHF. Oral flecainide was initiated and subsequently up-titrated because of persistent fetal tachycardia. Sinus rhythm was restored on treatment day 10, followed by complete sonographic resolution of hydrops by 32+6 weeks' gestation. Labor was induced at 38 weeks, resulting in vaginal delivery of a clinically stable male infant. Postnatally, prophylactic propranolol was started, but recurrent SVT on days 4 and 13 of life required escalation to flecainide and adenosine cardioversion before discharge in sinus rhythm. This case illustrates that regression of hydrops, rather than restoration of sinus rhythm alone, represents a more clinically meaningful marker of fetal cardiovascular recovery and underscores the importance of timely transplacental antiarrhythmic therapy and structured postnatal surveillance, given the well-documented risk of arrhythmia recurrence in infants with a history of fetal SVT complicated by hydrops.

AI.tldr: 胎儿室上速合并水肿经母体氟卡尼治疗10天恢复窦律、水肿完全消退，但出生后仍复发需升级治疗。
AI.motivation: 胎儿持续性室上速可导致心功能不全和非免疫性水肿，后者围产期病残率和死亡率高。地高辛虽为一线，但水肿胎儿胎盘转运受损；氟卡尼经胎盘生物利用度更高、转复率更优，需积累其逆转水肿的临床证据。
AI.method: 个案报告。31岁孕妇，孕30周胎儿超声示室上速，心室率约300次/分、1:1房室传导，伴腹水及心包积液符合非免疫性水肿。予口服氟卡尼并因持续心动过速上调剂量，观察胎儿心律转复及水肿消退情况，并追踪至分娩及新生儿期。
AI.result: 治疗第10天恢复窦性心律，孕32+6周水肿完全消退。孕38周引产经阴道分娩一男婴，临床稳定。新生儿予预防性普萘洛尔，但生后第4天和第13天复发室上速，升级为氟卡尼并腺苷转复，出院时窦律。摘要未报告具体剂量、氟卡尼血药浓度及统计检验。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示水肿消退较单纯窦律恢复更能反映胎儿心血管康复，支持对水肿胎儿及时经胎盘抗心律失常治疗；但胎儿室上速合并水肿者生后仍有较高复发风险，需规范新生儿期监测与治疗。单例报告不能推广，需更大样本验证。

summary_zh: 胎儿室上性心动过速（SVT）是主要的持续性胎儿快速性心律失常，当持续存在时，可进展为心动过速诱导的心肌功能障碍和非免疫性胎儿水肿（NIHF），后者与显著的围产期发病率和死亡率相关。尽管地高辛历来作为一线治疗，但氟卡尼在胎盘转运生物利用度方面更优，且在胎盘水肿可能损害地高辛转运的水肿胎儿中具有更高的心脏复律率。我们报告一例妊娠30周时并发胎儿水肿的胎儿SVT，在母体氟卡尼治疗后实现了完全的宫内逆转。一名31岁女性在胎儿超声心动图显示SVT伴心室率约300次/分和1:1房室传导，同时伴有符合NIHF的胎儿腹水和心包积液后被转诊。开始口服氟卡尼，并因胎儿心动过速持续而随后上调剂量。治疗第10天恢复窦性心律，随后在妊娠32+6周时水肿完全超声消退。38周时引产，经阴道分娩一名临床稳定的男婴。出生后开始预防性普萘洛尔，但出生第4天和第13天复发性SVT需要升级至氟卡尼和腺苷心脏复律，出院时恢复窦性心律。本病例说明，水肿消退而非仅恢复窦性心律，是胎儿心血管恢复更具临床意义的标志，并强调了及时经胎盘抗心律失常治疗和结构化出生后监测的重要性，鉴于有胎儿SVT并发水肿病史的婴儿中心律失常复发风险已有充分记录。

title: Stellate ganglion phototherapy for electrical storm during mechanical circulatory support in acute coronary syndrome: a case series.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Electrical storm (ES) during mechanical circulatory support (MCS) in the setting of acute coronary syndrome (ACS) represents a life-threatening condition driven by sympathetic hyperactivation and repolarization abnormalities. While stellate ganglion block is recognized as an effective autonomic modulation strategy for drug-refractory ventricular arrhythmias, its use may raise concerns regarding bleeding complications in patients receiving systemic anticoagulation. Stellate ganglion phototherapy (SGP) is a non-invasive alternative, but its clinical utility for ES under MCS remains unclear.

CASE SUMMARY: This case series describes two patients with drug-refractory ES complicating ACS during MCS management. Patient 1, a 78-year-old woman with cardiogenic shock, developed recurrent ventricular fibrillation (VF) with QT prolongation while on veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. Overdrive pacing caused haemodynamic deterioration, and conventional antiarrhythmic drugs failed. Following SGP initiation, no further VF requiring electrical shocks occurred. Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation was subsequently withdrawn. Patient 2, a 77-year-old man, developed recurrent torsades de pointes/VF with QT prolongation after left main revascularization under Impella support. Following SGP initiation, no further episodes requiring electrical shocks occurred. Impella was subsequently removed.

DISCUSSION: Stellate ganglion phototherapy may represent a non-invasive autonomic modulation strategy for drug-refractory ES in ACS patients requiring MCS. Although concomitant therapies and gradual recovery from myocardial ischaemia may have contributed to arrhythmia suppression, the temporal association suggests a potential contribution of SGP. Stellate ganglion phototherapy may serve as a bridge to recovery when invasive approaches pose additional challenges.

AI.tldr: 两例ACS合并电风暴患者在机械循环支持下接受星状神经节光疗后，无需电除颤的室颤发作停止，提示SGP可能作为非侵入性自主神经调节的桥接治疗。
AI.motivation: 急性冠脉综合征患者在接受机械循环支持期间发生电风暴是危及生命的状况，由交感神经过度激活和复极异常驱动。星状神经节阻滞是药物难治性室性心律失常的有效自主神经调节策略，但全身抗凝患者存在出血风险。星状神经节光疗是非侵入性替代方案，但其在机械循环支持下电风暴中的临床效用尚不明确。
AI.method: 病例系列研究，纳入2例急性冠脉综合征合并药物难治性电风暴、正在接受机械循环支持的患者。患者1为78岁女性，心源性休克，在VA-ECMO期间出现反复室颤伴QT延长；患者2为77岁男性，在Impella支持下左主干血运重建后出现反复尖端扭转型室速/室颤伴QT延长。干预为星状神经节光疗。主要观察指标为需要电除颤的室性心律失常发作。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 患者1在启动星状神经节光疗后，未再发生需要电除颤的室颤，随后撤除ECMO。患者2在启动星状神经节光疗后，未再发生需要电除颤的室性心律失常发作，随后移除Impella。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 星状神经节光疗可能作为急性冠脉综合征合并电风暴、需要机械循环支持患者的非侵入性自主神经调节策略。尽管同时进行的治疗和心肌缺血的逐渐恢复可能有助于抑制心律失常，但时间关联提示SGP的潜在贡献。SGP或可作为侵入性方法面临额外挑战时的恢复桥接。结论受限于病例系列设计和小样本量，需进一步研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）背景下接受机械循环支持（MCS）期间发生的电风暴（ES）是一种由交感神经过度激活和复极异常驱动的危及生命的状况。虽然星状神经节阻滞被认为是治疗药物难治性室性心律失常的有效自主神经调节策略，但其使用可能引起对接受全身抗凝治疗患者出血并发症的担忧。星状神经节光疗（SGP）是一种无创替代方法，但其在MCS下治疗ES的临床效用仍不明确。

病例摘要：本病例系列描述了在MCS管理期间并发ACS的药物难治性ES的两例患者。患者1，一名78岁女性心源性休克患者，在接受静脉-动脉体外膜肺氧合期间出现反复心室颤动（VF）伴QT间期延长。超速起搏导致血流动力学恶化，常规抗心律失常药物无效。开始SGP后，未再发生需要电击的VF。随后撤除了体外膜肺氧合。患者2，一名77岁男性患者，在Impella支持下左主干血运重建后出现反复尖端扭转型室速/VF伴QT间期延长。开始SGP后，未再发生需要电击的发作。随后移除了Impella。

讨论：星状神经节光疗可能代表一种针对需要MCS的ACS患者药物难治性ES的无创自主神经调节策略。尽管伴随治疗和心肌缺血的逐渐恢复可能有助于心律失常的抑制，但时间上的关联提示SGP可能有所贡献。当有创方法带来额外挑战时，星状神经节光疗可作为恢复的桥梁。

title: Cardio-respiratory-gated proton pencil beam scanning for cardiac ablation: workflow and end-to-end validation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Stereotactic Arrhythmia Radiotherapy (STAR) offers a non-invasive alternative for ventricular tachycardia ablation, yet motion management remains a critical challenge. While respiratory gating is established, cardiac gating requires a dedicated workflow and gating device.

METHODS: This study establishes and validates an end-to-end workflow for cardiorespiratory gated proton STAR in six healthy swine. Key innovations include a novel pencil-beam scanning (PBS) controller enabling mid-spot beam pausing and resumption, and the integration of CardioKit, an ultrasound-based image-guidance system for real-time soft-tissue tracking. The workflow was evaluated by comparing single-gated (respiratory only) and dual-gated (cardiorespiratory) delivery strategies, assessing system latency, dosimetric accuracy on dynamic phantoms, and motion tracking fidelity against 4D-CT benchmarks.

RESULTS: The upgraded PBS system demonstrated a gate response latency of <550 µs, effectively mitigating interplay effects in dynamic phantom measurements through gated beam deliveries. CardioKit provided respiratory motion traces highly correlated with 4D-CT data (Pearson r > 0.97) and responded to arrhythmic events within 5 ms. In vivo, dual-gating restricted delivery to the diastolic window (70-100% R-R), which resulted in a reduction in the Internal Target Volume (ITV) expansion by a mean of 45% compared to single-gating (19% vs. 64%), thereby substantially sparing healthy myocardium. Although dual-gating increased total beam-on time, the mid-spot interrupt capability ensured robust dose accumulation without treatment aborts.

CONCLUSION: The workflow for imaging, treatment planning, and cardiorespiratory-gated beam delivery was viable for treating all six subjects. The PBS system responded to gating commands < 550 µs and CardioKit responded to irregularities in heartbeat in <5 ms. Cardiorespiratory gating enabled an average 45% reduction in target expansion due to cardiac motion. Comparison of CardioKit respiratory motion traces with respiratory 4D-CT yielded differences of 1.1-1.4 mm in total motion amplitude and 0.97-0.99 Pearson correlation factor. These findings are valuable for establishing a workflow for cardiorespiratory-gated STAR treatment with CardioKit.

AI.tldr: 在六只健康猪中验证了心呼吸双门控质子束扫描消融工作流，双门控将内靶区外扩平均减少45%（19% vs 64%），系统门控响应<550微秒。
AI.motivation: 立体定向心律失常放疗（STAR）为室性心动过速消融提供无创替代方案，但运动管理是关键挑战。呼吸门控已成熟，而心脏门控需要专用工作流和门控设备，既往证据缺乏端到端验证。
AI.method: 研究在六只健康猪中建立并验证心呼吸门控质子STAR的端到端工作流。关键创新包括新型笔束扫描（PBS）控制器实现束流中点暂停与恢复，以及整合基于超声的CardioKit实时软组织追踪系统。比较单门控（仅呼吸）与双门控（心呼吸）策略，评估系统延迟、动态体模剂量学精度及运动追踪保真度（以4D-CT为基准）。
AI.result: 升级PBS系统门控响应延迟<550微秒，有效减轻动态体模中的交互效应。CardioKit呼吸运动轨迹与4D-CT高度相关（Pearson r>0.97），对心律失常事件响应<5毫秒。体内双门控将照射限制于舒张窗（R-R间期70-100%），内靶区（ITV）外扩较单门控平均减少45%（19% vs 64%），显著保护健康心肌。双门控增加总束流时间，但束流中点中断能力确保剂量稳健累积且无治疗中止。
AI.conclusion: 心呼吸门控质子STAR工作流在全部六只受试者中可行。PBS系统门控响应<550微秒，CardioKit对心跳不规则响应<5毫秒。双门控使心脏运动所致靶区外扩平均减少45%。CardioKit与4D-CT呼吸运动轨迹总振幅差异1.1-1.4毫米，Pearson相关系数0.97-0.99。这些发现为建立心呼吸门控STAR联合CardioKit的工作流提供了依据，但样本为健康猪，临床转化需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：立体定向心律失常放射治疗（STAR）为室性心动过速消融提供了一种非侵入性替代方案，但运动管理仍然是一个关键挑战。虽然呼吸门控已经确立，但心脏门控需要专门的工作流程和门控设备。

方法：本研究在六只健康猪中建立并验证了心肺门控质子STAR的端到端工作流程。关键创新包括一种新型笔形束扫描（PBS）控制器，可实现束流中点暂停和恢复，以及整合了CardioKit——一种基于超声的图像引导系统，用于实时软组织追踪。通过比较单门控（仅呼吸）和双门控（心肺）递送策略，评估系统延迟、动态体模上的剂量学准确性以及与4D-CT基准相比的运动追踪保真度，来评估该工作流程。

结果：升级后的PBS系统表现出<550 µs的门控响应延迟，通过门控束流递送有效减轻了动态体模测量中的交互效应。CardioKit提供的呼吸运动轨迹与4D-CT数据高度相关（Pearson r > 0.97），并在5 ms内对心律失常事件做出响应。在体内，双门控将递送限制在舒张期窗口（70-100% R-R），与单门控相比，内靶区（ITV）外扩平均减少45%（19% vs. 64%），从而显著保护了健康心肌。尽管双门控增加了总束流开启时间，但束流中点中断能力确保了稳健的剂量累积，且无治疗中止。

结论：成像、治疗计划和心肺门控束流递送的工作流程对于治疗所有六名受试者是可行的。PBS系统对门控命令的响应<550 µs，CardioKit对心跳不规则的响应<5 ms。心肺门控使因心脏运动导致的靶区外扩平均减少45%。将CardioKit呼吸运动轨迹与呼吸4D-CT比较，总运动幅度差异为1.1-1.4 mm，Pearson相关系数为0.97-0.99。这些发现对于建立使用CardioKit的心肺门控STAR治疗工作流程具有重要价值。

title: Aborted sudden cardiac death in children and adolescents-from acute management to diagnosis.
summary: Aborted sudden cardiac death (SCD) in children and adolescents is terrifying for patients and families. Inherited arrhythmia syndromes, cardiomyopathies, and coronary anomalies are the most common associations. This review provides a comprehensive framework for diagnostic evaluation in survivors of resuscitated sudden cardiac arrest. After hemodynamic stabilization and neuroprotection, evaluation often requires data retrieval, structured cardiac phenotyping, and obtaining samples to assess for molecular, metabolic or toxicology analysis. A tiered approach is essential. A surface electrocardiogram (ECG) and echocardiography remain first line investigations. Primary electrical diseases may be evident on a standard and modified ECG, including Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) syndrome, conduction abnormalities, myocardial ischemia, and some cardiac channelopathies. Early echocardiography assesses structural heart disease, cardiomyopathies and myocarditis. Special attention should be paid to anomalous origin of the coronary arteries and recent work has emphasized the importance of mitral annular disjunction. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, exercise stress testing, and drug provocation testing can be useful supplements to reveal concealed substrates. Genetic testing is vital for precision medicine and cascade family screening, often requiring a multidisciplinary team to assess variants of uncertain significance (VUS) and complex genomic findings. Ultimately, the critical step is genotype-phenotype correlation, where the team determines whether the genetic and clinical data reinforce one another to provide a diagnosis, refine treatment, and prevent future tragedies within affected families.

AI.tldr: 儿童青少年心脏骤停复苏幸存者需采用分层诊断策略，结合ECG、超声心动图、心脏磁共振、运动负荷试验、药物激发试验和基因检测，通过基因型-表型关联明确病因并指导家族筛查。
AI.motivation: 儿童青少年心脏骤停对家庭打击巨大，常见病因包括遗传性心律失常综合征、心肌病和冠状动脉异常。目前缺乏针对复苏幸存者系统化诊断评估的框架，既往证据多聚焦成人，儿童青少年人群的诊断路径和基因检测应用尚待明确。
AI.method: 本文为综述，针对复苏后血流动力学稳定且完成神经保护的儿童青少年心脏骤停幸存者，提出分层诊断评估框架。评估内容包括数据回顾、结构化心脏表型分析、分子/代谢/毒理学样本采集；一线检查为体表心电图和超声心动图，补充检查包括心脏磁共振、运动负荷试验和药物激发试验，基因检测用于精准医学和家族级联筛查，最终由多学科团队进行基因型-表型关联分析。摘要未报告样本量及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据或统计结果。综述指出标准及改良心电图可识别WPW综合征、传导异常、心肌缺血及部分心脏离子通道病；早期超声心动图可评估结构性心脏病、心肌病和心肌炎，需特别关注冠状动脉起源异常及二尖瓣环分离；心脏磁共振、运动负荷试验和药物激发试验有助于揭示隐匿性基质；基因检测对精准医学和家族筛查至关重要，但常需多学科团队评估意义未明变异和复杂基因组发现。
AI.conclusion: 儿童青少年心脏骤停幸存者的诊断核心是分层评估与基因型-表型关联，以明确病因、优化治疗并预防家族中未来悲剧。该框架强调多学科协作和基因检测在精准诊断及家族筛查中的价值，但作为综述缺乏原始数据验证，临床推广需结合各中心资源与多学科可及性。

summary_zh: 儿童和青少年中发生的顿挫性心脏性猝死（SCD）对患者和家庭而言是极其可怕的。遗传性心律失常综合征、心肌病和冠状动脉异常是最常见的相关病因。本综述为复苏成功的心脏骤停幸存者的诊断评估提供了一个全面的框架。在血流动力学稳定和神经保护之后，评估通常需要数据检索、结构化心脏表型分析，以及获取样本以进行分子、代谢或毒理学分析。分层方法至关重要。体表心电图（ECG）和超声心动图仍是首选检查。原发性电疾病可能在标准和改良ECG上显现，包括Wolff-Parkinson-White（WPW）综合征、传导异常、心肌缺血和某些心脏通道病。早期超声心动图评估结构性心脏病、心肌病和心肌炎。应特别关注冠状动脉起源异常，近期研究强调了二尖瓣环分离的重要性。心脏磁共振成像、运动负荷试验和药物激发试验可作为揭示隐匿基质的有效补充。基因检测对于精准医学和家系级联筛查至关重要，通常需要多学科团队来评估意义不明的变异（VUS）和复杂的基因组发现。最终，关键步骤是基因型-表型关联，即团队确定遗传和临床数据是否相互印证，以提供诊断、优化治疗并预防受影响家庭未来的悲剧。

title: Optogenetic and sonogenetic pacing of unmodified cardiac tissue upon quick integration with specialized biological actuators.
summary: Electrical stimulation for cardiac pacing has been in clinical use for 100 years and it is the current standard. Alternative scalable pacing methods that are contactless, with good spatial precision and can also be cell-selective are of interest for both in vitro and in vivo applications. Cardiac pacing by light or by ultrasound (US) can be achieved using optogenetic transduction of the tissue and by enhancing responsiveness to ultrasound. In this work we create specialized biological actuators (cell spheroids) out of generic human cells, modified optogenetically (using Channelrhodopsin2) and sonogenetically (using human Piezo1), guide them to a desired location to promote quick integration with unmodified cardiac syncytia within less than two hours. We quantify their ability to confer pacing by light or US and to entrain the native cardiac tissue, modeled here with human induced pluripotent stem cell derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) grown in monolayers, quasi-3D oriented microtissues or cell spheroids. Magnetic guidance (via magnetic nanoparticles) speeds up integration and facilitates positioning to optimize electrotonic load for pacing; size match and three-dimensional growth also accelerate integration. Computational modeling corroborates the possibility to pace by light and by US. Using optogenetically-gated US pulses (0.5 MHz), we show entrainment in voltage and calcium responses and identify the best performing configurations. Experiments reveal the potential role of Piezo1, esp. when activated with Yoda1. The approach is shown to work with physiologically relevant heart cells, such as human cardiac fibroblasts as optimized actuators, and therefore can be considered for in vivo applications as part of heart regeneration efforts. High-throughput cardiotoxicity testing and drug screening in vitro can directly benefit from deployment of such biological actuators.

AI.tldr: 研究开发了经光遗传学或声遗传学修饰的细胞球体作为生物致动器，可在2小时内快速整合未修饰心肌组织，实现光或超声起搏并成功驱动hiPSC-CMs的电压和钙响应。
AI.motivation: 传统电刺激起搏虽为临床标准，但非接触、空间精准且可细胞选择性的替代起搏方法在体外和体内应用中具有重要价值。光遗传学和声遗传学起搏需对组织进行基因修饰，而如何快速、精准地将致动器整合到未修饰心肌组织并实现有效起搏尚待解决。
AI.method: 研究构建了经Channelrhodopsin2光遗传学修饰或人Piezo1声遗传学修饰的通用人类细胞球体作为生物致动器，利用磁性纳米颗粒引导定位，促进其与未修饰的心脏合胞体（hiPSC-CMs单层、准3D微组织或细胞球体）在2小时内快速整合。量化其通过光或超声（0.5 MHz）起搏并驱动原生心肌组织的能力，并通过计算建模验证。
AI.result: 光遗传学门控超声脉冲（0.5 MHz）可成功驱动电压和钙响应，并确定了最佳配置。实验揭示了Piezo1的作用，尤其在Yoda1激活时。该策略在生理相关的心脏细胞（如优化的人心脏成纤维细胞致动器）中有效。摘要未报告具体的效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 该生物致动器方法可在短时间内整合未修饰心肌组织，实现光或超声非接触起搏，并可能作为心脏再生策略的一部分用于体内应用，同时直接有益于体外高通量心脏毒性测试和药物筛选。但研究目前限于体外模型，体内有效性和长期安全性需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 电刺激心脏起搏已在临床应用100年，是目前的标准方法。替代性的可扩展起搏方法，如非接触式、具有良好空间精度且可细胞选择性的方法，对于体外和体内应用均具有意义。通过光或超声（US）进行心脏起搏，可利用组织的光遗传学转导和增强对超声的响应性来实现。在本工作中，我们利用通用人类细胞创建了专门的生物致动器（细胞球体），这些细胞经过光遗传学（使用Channelrhodopsin2）和声遗传学（使用人类Piezo1）修饰，引导至所需位置，以在不到两小时内促进与未修饰心脏合胞体的快速整合。我们量化了它们通过光或US赋予起搏并驱动原生心脏组织的能力，此处以单层生长的人诱导多能干细胞衍生心肌细胞（hiPSC-CMs）、准3D定向微组织或细胞球体为模型。磁引导（通过磁性纳米颗粒）加速整合并促进定位以优化起搏的电紧张负荷；尺寸匹配和三维生长也加速整合。计算模型证实了通过光和US起搏的可能性。使用光遗传学门控的US脉冲（0.5 MHz），我们展示了电压和钙反应的驱动，并确定了最佳性能配置。实验揭示了Piezo1的潜在作用，尤其是当用Yoda1激活时。该方法被证明适用于生理相关的心脏细胞，如作为优化致动器的人类心脏成纤维细胞，因此可考虑作为心脏再生努力的一部分用于体内应用。体外高通量心脏毒性测试和药物筛选可直接受益于此类生物致动器的部署。
